EC1: - Refusal of the patients to take part in the trial
EC2: - Presence of distant metastases (UICC stage IVC)
EC3: - Previous radiotherapy in the head [OR] and neck region
EC4: - Second malignancy that is likely to require treatment during the trial intervention or follow-up period or that, in the opinion of the physician, has a considerable risk of recurrence [OR] or metastases within the follow-up period
EC5: - Serious disease [OR] or medical condition [AND] with life expectancy of less than one year
EC6: - Participation in competing interventional trial on cancer treatment
EC7: - Patients who are not suitable for radiochemotherapy
EC9: - Patients [NOT] not able to understand the character and individual consequences of the trial
